title: City walk.
text: Our tour guide Lara was exceptional in her knowledge and enthusiasm for her beautiful city. Would highly recommend this tour as both value for money and enjoyment.
author: CodaRed

title: Guias Tours are the Experts on Seville
text: Guias Sevilla Tours provided a fantastic experience for my wife and me, creating a custom, 7-hour itinerary.  Our guide, Melisa, was fun and authentic, and went out of her way on her day off to support us.  Melisa took us through the Real Alcazar and gardens, the Cathedral, walked us through a tapas lunch, the former Jewish quarter, and much more with many points of interest explained.  Guias arranged all the entrance fees for us, and Melisa knew the security folks at nearly every venue resulting in hassle-free entry!
author: Coombsjl
